prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Two adult male friends aged 31 and 35 sit opposite each other at a small neighbourhood cafe table, one listening with a warm smile as the other tells a story. Plain ceramic cups and an unmarked window frame the moment. Photograph from beside the table in soft window daylight, keeping both faces clear and their posture relaxed. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances: the 31-year-old man has tightly cropped dark curls, round glasses and a lean build; the 35-year-old has straight sandy hair brushed to one side, light stubble and a broad comfortable build. Their heads and relaxed hands stay above the quiet lower margin.
Composition priority: exact 4:5 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
review: Reviewed full vertical image: two male friends converse at a cafe, one dark-curly-haired with round glasses and one sandy-haired with stubble. One rests his chin on a bent hand; the other gestures with two correctly connected hands and plausible visible fingers. Cups, faces and table are coherent, lower foreground is quiet.
